name: Iron Cross
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing in. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight with a slight bend at the elbows, raise both dumbbells out to your sides until your arms are parallel to the floor and your body forms a cross.
Hold for a second at the top without shrugging your shoulders or leaning back.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your sides.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
